card.name: Digits just before a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts or sits inside a number, right before a decimal point or the next digit, as in 3.8% or 1.25 mg/min. Seen in trial percentages, dose tables, and dates.

modes.label: Percent in trial results
modes.description: A digit inside a percentage of patients, just before the decimal.
modes.example: discontinued in 20 (<<3>>.8%) due to elevated liver function

modes.label: Dose and rate tables
modes.description: A leading digit of a dose, rate, or volume before a decimal.

modes.label: Dates and measures
modes.description: A digit in a day of the month or in a converted measurement.

card.writes: It suppresses other digit tokens, so it discourages another digit from following and favors a decimal point or unit.
card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number, where the next piece is probably a decimal point or unit and not another digit.
